title: Windows release links deterministically, so two builds of one commit are byte-identical
outcome: Windows release links deterministically, so two builds of one commit are byte-identical
acceptance: The repository's Cargo configuration passes /Brepro or an equivalent deterministic-link option for the windows-msvc linker only.

A controlled pair of release builds of one clean commit in two worktrees produces byte-identical executables with the option enabled; commands, toolchain, source state and runtime-derived comparison numbers are recorded in a holder note, with no pinned hash.
The full gate passes on the exact changeset.
